description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): enforce a club's max_members cap from BOTH member-creation and member-transfer mutation paths
prompts: Clubs gain an optional `max_members` field (a non-negative integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/clubs and return it in club responses. Add `PATCH /api/members/:member_id`, body `{ club_id }`, which transfers a member to a different club. The invariant to enforce: a club's member count must never exceed its max_members. This must be validated from BOTH places that can newly add a member to a club: (1) POST /api/clubs/:club_id/members (member creation), and (2) PATCH /api/members/:member_id when `club_id` is changed to a DIFFERENT club than the member's current one - both must reject with 400 if the target club is already at capacity. 'Transferring' a member to the club they're already in is a no-op and must always be allowed.

reference_solution.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "axum_bookclub"
version = "0.4.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
http-body-util = "0.1"
